AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.cheaper_path: Ordinary code review and direct knowledge may already realize the selected functions.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.dependency_order: Concerns and direct observations inform a local design choice; discussion, implementation and checking may iterate in any useful order.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.failure_or_reversal: A newly consequential external contract or repeated misunderstood changes defeats the small-scope assumption and warrants targeted additional evidence.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.joint_cost: Conversation, a small check and occasional rationale consume developer attention; even these are omitted when they lack a consumer. They share the same scarce developer time, so no independent net-benefit additions are assumed.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.observation_need: One meaningful interface/change/quality question and a real cheap alternative, including the current design.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.omission_test: Removing ATAM, ADLs, view packages and a separate office leaves no unaddressed concern under the guard; removing the relevant contract check would lose protection.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.purpose: Answer a few consequential questions without creating an architecture bureaucracy.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.retirement_path: Delete unused descriptions/checks after confirming that the protected concern or consumer has disappeared.

alternative_configurations.ESCALATION_TRIGGER: Growing consequence reach, turnover, unobserved risk or recurring cross-boundary change.
alternative_configurations.FORM: Direct conversation, simple local design, one relevant alternative/quality check, and a short rationale only for a non-obvious durable choice.
alternative_configurations.GUARD: Few consequential interfaces, shared current understanding, low change exposure.
alternative_configurations.NAME: Small stable one-team application
alternative_configurations.OMISSIONS: No automatic ATAM event, ADL, multi-view package, service split, debt programme or adaptation controller. Ordinary engineering can supply the functions.
alternative_configurations.RETIREMENT: Remove a control when its protected concern or consumer disappears without undermining another obligation.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.cheaper_path: One authoritative contract and a concise decision note can replace several synchronized representations.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.dependency_order: Local teams act concurrently within shared commitments; concern/rationale/conformance information feeds decisions and observed deviations reopen only affected claims.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.failure_or_reversal: A new central review becomes a bottleneck without finding distinct risk; simplify to contract-local review. Conversely, uncoordinated shared-data changes require a stronger local shared mechanism.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.joint_cost: The same experienced people often elicit concerns, review designs, maintain views and triage conformance. Summed person-hours, queue delays and transition costs can exceed capacity even when each practice seems cheap alone.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.observation_need: Current semantic interfaces, shared invariants, selected quality scenarios and actual implementation mappings; consumer evidence for retained records.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.omission_test: A multi-view package and a review on every edit are unnecessary. Omitting every cross-team contract or losing non-obvious rationale creates a different failure class.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.purpose: Coordinate consequential interfaces and evolution across teams and turnover.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.retirement_path: Collapse forums and mappings after team/dependency consolidation, preserving still-used knowledge and unresolved obligations.

alternative_configurations.ESCALATION_TRIGGER: A concrete high-consequence interaction may justify focused formal analysis or a migration experiment.
alternative_configurations.FORM: Selected shared contracts and views, retrievable decisions, contextual conformance and proportionate evaluations; local design proceeds concurrently inside shared constraints.
alternative_configurations.GUARD: Cross-team semantic/quality obligations, turnover and significant change.
alternative_configurations.NAME: Long-lived multi-team product
alternative_configurations.OMISSIONS: No forced one-team-per-component mapping, universal documentation set or full review for every edit.
alternative_configurations.RETIREMENT: Collapse coordination/description layers that no longer protect active cross-team obligations.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.cheaper_path: A known simpler connector or bounded direct protocol test may remove the need for a novel proof.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.dependency_order: Formal model construction and real-system observation constrain one another; proof checking does not precede every design action in a universal sequence.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.failure_or_reversal: A new interaction lies outside CSP assumptions, or correspondence cannot be credibly maintained; narrow the claim, change the model or use a different evidence method.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.joint_cost: Specialist modeling, state-space management, implementation correspondence and regression checks draw on common scarce expertise. A small proof may hide a large abstraction-validation burden.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.observation_need: Exact theorem/model premises plus evidence that the relevant ports, roles, glue and environment correspond to implementation.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.omission_test: Removing formal checking can be acceptable if another method meets the narrow assurance need; removing correspondence while claiming realized assurance is not acceptable.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.purpose: Establish a tractable high-consequence interaction property while bounding model-to-system transfer.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.retirement_path: Retire a proof obligation when the protected interaction disappears; preserve the historical model without treating it as current.

alternative_configurations.ESCALATION_TRIGGER: Model mismatch, new interaction or a consequence outside the chosen semantics.
alternative_configurations.FORM: Focused formal analysis with explicit theorem conditions plus empirical/correspondence checks for the environment.
alternative_configurations.GUARD: A tractable formal property is material and its realisation can be checked.
alternative_configurations.NAME: High-consequence modelled interaction
alternative_configurations.OMISSIONS: No claim that the whole system is verified or that formal proof supplies stakeholder authority.
alternative_configurations.RETIREMENT: Use a cheaper model/test when the formally protected interaction no longer exists or its consequence is no longer material.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.cheaper_path: A fixed configuration or occasional manual change is adequate when variability is low or automation has negative net benefit.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.dependency_order: Probe → model update → constrained choice → effector → outcome observation is a causal loop; policy revision is separately reassessed. This is a runtime loop, not a required organizational workflow.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.failure_or_reversal: Lost observation validity or unavailable effectors should trigger the applicable conservative fallback or operator path; no universally safe fallback is presumed.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.joint_cost: Sensing, model maintenance, actuation and recovery consume the same compute and operator capacity. Multiple controllers can oscillate or compete even when each is stable in isolation.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.observation_need: Probe validity including silent/stale errors, action semantics, shared resources, constraints and outcome observations.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.omission_test: A redundant dashboard can be omitted; removing the only valid observation or external constraint check invalidates the adaptive claim.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.purpose: Adapt a changing system within an established and observable operating envelope.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.retirement_path: Disable unnecessary adaptation when conditions stabilize, and retire its probes only after checking other consumers.

alternative_configurations.ESCALATION_TRIGGER: Lost observation validity, unavailable effectors, interacting-controller risk or a needed action outside delegation.
alternative_configurations.FORM: Valid observations and model translations feed a constrained decision mechanism; effectors change the system; subsequent observations test the outcome; engineers retain policy-revision accountability.
alternative_configurations.GUARD: Changing operation justifies automated reconfiguration and a valid action/evidence envelope exists.
alternative_configurations.NAME: Bounded runtime adaptation
alternative_configurations.OMISSIONS: No open-ended self-authorisation or automatic revision of external constraints.
alternative_configurations.RETIREMENT: Prefer stable configuration/operator procedure if variability or net benefit disappears.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.cheaper_path: Separate small implementations or one genuinely shared model may be cheaper than a family platform plus translation layer.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.dependency_order: Commonality/variation analysis and semantic translation inform interfaces and valid combinations; family and context partitions may overlap without coinciding.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.failure_or_reversal: The proposed common model accumulates exceptions or the family has too little commonality; split or simplify it rather than preserving reuse for its own sake.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.joint_cost: Variation mechanisms, translators, compatibility testing and migration coexistence can multiply rather than add costs as combinations grow. Shared translators create new coupling and ownership burden.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.observation_need: Real member/consumer needs, valid variant combinations and translations preserving each context’s meaning.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.omission_test: Service splitting and a full product-line programme are unnecessary. Removing a required translation or a combination constraint can break meaning or quality.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.purpose: Manage actual variants and different domain meanings without confusing them with deployment boundaries.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.retirement_path: Remove unused variation and translation after the last actual consumer disappears; keep valid remaining combinations explicit.

alternative_configurations.ESCALATION_TRIGGER: New variant/context invalidates an interface or shared quality assumption.
alternative_configurations.FORM: Explicit commonality/variation and model-context boundaries with tested translation and valid combination conditions.
alternative_configurations.GUARD: Real variants or multiple semantic contexts require shared and distinct obligations.
alternative_configurations.NAME: Family or heterogeneous domain composition
alternative_configurations.OMISSIONS: No conclusion about unread product-line economics or mandatory microservice deployment.
alternative_configurations.RETIREMENT: Remove unused variation points and translations after consumers disappear.

composition_candidate_history.alternative: Fixed policy or manual action can avoid the composite obligation where adequate.
composition_candidate_history.ceiling: Analytic consequence; no new universal safety theorem or independent empirical validation.
composition_candidate_history.composite_bearer: A changing architecture-based controller and its sensing/model/decision/action chain.
composition_candidate_history.criterion: A policy or observation change does not retain a claim whose relevant premise was invalidated.
composition_candidate_history.derivation: Observation validity, model correspondence and scoped reopening jointly require reassessing the affected assumption chain.
composition_candidate_history.name: Composed adaptation evidence continuity
composition_candidate_history.removal_test: Without correspondence, unit mismatch can pass; without reopening, the old claim persists. However ESA-063 already expresses assurance-assumption revision and includes the needed conditions.
composition_candidate_history.subsumption: Subsumed by existing ESA-063 plus its stated dependencies.
composition_candidate_history.witness: Changing a sensor unit leaves a numerical threshold unchanged; every local operation runs but the control interpretation is wrong.

composition_candidate_history.alternative: Remove duplicate coverage, sequence genuinely needed checks or use an adequate smaller method.
composition_candidate_history.ceiling: Constructed finite capacity counterexample; does not estimate actual study or target costs.
composition_candidate_history.composite_bearer: A selected configuration consuming shared developer, specialist and runtime resources.
composition_candidate_history.criterion: The combination is feasible and its protection justifies total rather than independently counted cost.
composition_candidate_history.derivation: Shared resource limits and interactions invalidate summing standalone net-benefit estimates without examining the portfolio.
composition_candidate_history.name: Joint architecture-control affordability
composition_candidate_history.removal_test: Dropping explicit economic modelling still permits a direct capacity comparison, so ESA-029 is not a necessary parent. Feasibility is already within ESA-017/026 and proportionality in ESA-056.
composition_candidate_history.subsumption: Existing guarded feasibility and proportionality criteria cover the proposed additional identity.
composition_candidate_history.witness: Two four-hour reviews individually fit a six-hour weekly specialist budget; together they do not, even before coordination overhead.

composition_candidate_history.alternative: Use only checked bounded tasks and retain established decision responsibility.
composition_candidate_history.ceiling: No impossibility result; bounded positive assistance and benchmark progress remain admitted at their proper scopes.
composition_candidate_history.composite_bearer: An automated system that recovers, proposes, evaluates and changes architecture.
composition_candidate_history.criterion: Reliable open-ended end-to-end architecting under changed requirements.
composition_candidate_history.derivation: The proposed inference from verified local tasks to the broader criterion is invalid without integration, distribution-shift and operational evidence.
composition_candidate_history.name: Trustworthy architecture automation
composition_candidate_history.removal_test: Each local task can be valid while the composite remains unvalidated; adding all parents does not discharge the missing premise.
composition_candidate_history.subsumption: Not a new supported property; the broader claim is already ESA-060.
composition_candidate_history.witness: A pipeline produces a valid diagram and passing tests while omitting a global data invariant.

external_interfaces.BOUNDARY: Architecture findings do not settle product-line economics or whole-lane synthesis.
external_interfaces.INPUTS: Validated family scope, variants, common assets and production/economic requirements from a later independent study.
external_interfaces.NAME: Software product-line inquiry
external_interfaces.OUTPUTS: Commonality/variation constraints, semantic interface assumptions and per-configuration quality obligations.

external_interfaces.BOUNDARY: Neither a model, review nor this research grants authority or establishes legal compliance.
external_interfaces.INPUTS: Actual stakeholder commitments, organisational delegation, provider contracts and applicable external constraints.
external_interfaces.NAME: External authority and accountability
external_interfaces.OUTPUTS: Options, risks, proposed changes and observations of their consequences.

body.relation_interpretation: Relations are guarded functional dependencies or evidence/communication relations. A bundled endpoint list is read with the individual assessment and native guard; it does not mandate full branded methods or every artifact. Converses are not inferred. Historical analogy is separate from causal/functional composition.

relation_semantics.ACTS_THROUGH: FROM is realised through the mechanisms named in TO.
relation_semantics.ALTERNATIVE_TO: Guarded selection/substitution, not simultaneous mandatory use.
relation_semantics.ANALOGOUS_TO: A bounded comparison of different mechanisms; no historical common ancestor, transmission or semantic equivalence is asserted.
relation_semantics.COMMUNICATES_TO: FROM carries information or commitments to the consumer in TO.
relation_semantics.CONFLICTS_WITH: Incompatible claims/assumptions; rejected candidates are not requirements.
relation_semantics.CONSTRAINS: FROM limits admissible use of TO.
relation_semantics.ENABLES: FROM supplies a capability or input TO can use.
relation_semantics.FEEDBACK_TO: Observations/findings at FROM can reopen or revise TO.
relation_semantics.PROVIDES_EVIDENCE_FOR: FROM contributes evidence to TO without automatically proving it.
relation_semantics.REFINES: FROM narrows or adds conditions to TO.
relation_semantics.REQUIRES: FROM needs the TO condition/mechanism under the guard; not a global sequencing rule.
relation_semantics.SUPERSEDES: FROM replaces the specified candidate meaning in TO while preserving the denominator.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Significance needs an affected concern; a measurable quality scenario is additionally needed when significance rests on a response claim. The native endpoints are interpreted as these conditional functions, not a mandatory six-field artifact for every important decision.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A consequential contract choice is justified qualitatively without a separate scenario document.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Having a scenario does not make its subject architecturally significant.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Significance requires a consequential concern connection. When it rests on a quality-response assertion, a sufficiently specific scenario makes that assertion assessable; this does not require a separate six-field artifact for every decision.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Significance is claimed because of stakeholder/quality consequences.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Importance determined solely by rank, file size or template.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Elicitation overhead can exceed the value of a local choice.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Consequences can be connected to real concerns.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Establish actual consequence reach in a later system.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Concerns provide information to the actor and scenario-selection processes; this communication does not confer authority or make elicitation representative.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: All listed stakeholder wishes are recorded but an affected operator is absent.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: An authorized decision path does not prove all concerns were communicated.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Concerns inform who must decide and which quality cases need examination.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Several parties have consequential concerns.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Workshop attendance or majority preference proves complete coverage.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Missing or powerless participants may be hidden by apparent agreement.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Affected participants or credible representatives can provide relevant conditions.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Identify missing perspectives and actual decision authority.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Specified scenarios can discriminate tactic and option consequences, provided selection and response semantics fit the question.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: Warm median requests select a design that fails the decisive cold-start tail case.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: An alternative can be justified by another adequate method without the complete scenario-method package.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Scenarios make tactic effects and alternative trade-offs assessable.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A quality claim must discriminate between designs.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A precise but unrepresentative scenario is sufficient.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Overspecified examples can anchor design too early.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Scenario meaning and relevant population are explicit.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Validate the selected scenario population and response measures.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Existing authority constrains actions changing shared commitments, including migration and controller policy; this is a boundary on action, not an additional approval hierarchy.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A controller relaxes a neighboring service’s quota to improve its own score.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A technically valid action does not establish the mandate to perform it.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Only actually authorised changes proceed through the relevant participants or bounded effectors.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Architectural actions change shared commitments or delegated control.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Identifying a risk or generating a recommendation automatically permits action.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Approval latency or overcentralisation can obstruct harmless local work.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Authority and capability exist independently of the evidence producer.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: A real system must supply the legitimate mandate; this packet grants none.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Representation-dependent inferences inherit correspondence and observation limits from the architecture/description distinction.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A consistent set of diagrams describes the wrong deployment version.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Accurate correspondence does not validate the quality of the described architecture.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Every representation-dependent conclusion carries a correspondence and observation scope.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A representation supports a claim about real software.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A model property is automatically an implementation property.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Maintaining mappings adds cost and may itself drift.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Model, belief and implementation are distinguishable.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Establish correspondence only to the degree needed for the actual decision.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Hiding a likely-changing decision requires an interface that does not leak it and attention to the dependency kind relevant to the change.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A format is private in code but duplicated in a shared database schema.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: An explicit interface and dependency graph do not imply useful information hiding.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Hidden choices remain local only when interface assumptions and relevant dependency kinds are adequate.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A boundary is claimed to localise a likely change.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Syntactic separation proves semantic independence.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Too much contract detail can expose or freeze the hidden decision.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Clients depend only on stated stable obligations.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Test representative change and interaction cases.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Semantic assumptions and connectors make meaningful composition assessable across reuse, styles and deployment; they are enabling inputs rather than sufficient containment.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: Two well-specified services still compete for one resource pool.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Containment can be adequate in a simple arrangement without separate connector documents.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Semantic contracts and connector mechanisms supply the basis for judging meaningful composition.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Parts communicate or are reused/distributed.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Endpoint matching or style naming is sufficient compatibility.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Contract maintenance and adapters add coordination/translation costs.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The actual interaction and external effects are understood.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Discover relevant hidden state, resource and failure assumptions.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Dependency and recovery observations inform boundary and conformance judgments without deciding their desired direction.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A call graph suggests no coordination although a shared dataset changes both teams’ work.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A sensible boundary does not validate a particular extraction method.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Recovered dependency evidence informs placement, coordination and rule checks without deciding them by itself.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Boundary, work coordination or conformance depends on a relation.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: All graphs represent correctness or work dependence.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: False or missing edges can misdirect organisational or code changes.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Extraction is typed and scoped to the relation being inferred.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Validate the extracted relation against the consumer’s question.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: CORRECT TO CONSTRAINS: coordination-aware placement is a selection criterion for service or local deployment. It is not itself an alternative deployment mechanism.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: Treating the criterion as a substitute for a deployable arrangement leaves the system’s actual packaging unspecified.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Either arrangement can be chosen for other justified concerns; its presence does not prove coordination adequacy.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Coordination-aware placement constrains the selection of a distributed or local arrangement according to consequential dependencies; ESA-REL042 is the actual alternative relation between those deployment choices.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A decomposition can be separately deployed or remain local.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Distribution is the default endpoint of modular maturity.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: A wrong independence forecast can make either arrangement costly.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Both alternatives are assessed on shared concerns and costs.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Compare actual release, scaling, fault and semantic needs.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Shared conceptual obligations constrain otherwise local choice; coherent concepts need not imply one model or one authority everywhere.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: Two contexts use an identical field name with incompatible meaning despite uniform tooling.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Local autonomy can preserve coherence, but decentralization alone does not create it.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Local autonomy and translations must preserve the shared invariant or expose a changed contract.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Independent teams/models share a conceptual obligation.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Conceptual integrity means uniform technology or central approval of every choice.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Excess shared vocabulary can suppress legitimate domain differences.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Only the genuinely shared semantics need common treatment.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Determine which meanings are truly common to affected consumers.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Explicit context and translation reasoning can reveal semantic interface and variation obligations; it cannot establish that a family or service split is valuable.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: An unnecessary translation layer duplicates a genuinely common small model.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A useful family boundary need not originate in DDD.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Context maps reveal where a shared model or explicit translation is required.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Domain meanings diverge or variants require different models.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Bounded context equals process, team or deployment boundary.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Translation and shared-kernel coordination may overwhelm reuse savings.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Context boundaries identify where semantic rules hold.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Validate boundary examples and permitted variations.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: A proposed family must justify its flexibility and valid combinations, with interface and quality conditions appropriate to the variants.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: An optional feature combination violates a shared timing constraint although each feature works alone.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Justified flexibility and compatible interfaces do not establish that a real family exists.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Family support depends on justified flexibility, compatible interfaces and quality validity of combinations.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A family architecture is proposed.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Speculative reuse warrants every variation point.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Combinatorial variation and cross-variant quality changes add work.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Required variants and shared assumptions are credible.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: A later family study must establish actual members, combinations and economics.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: A claimed realized tactic payoff is limited by interacting qualities and adequate observation; a purely model-internal result must instead keep that narrower scope.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: Caching improves the predicted latency but worsens consistency under invalidation failure.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Observing a quality improvement does not identify the tactic as its cause.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Competing consequences constrain the tactic and observations test its predicted response.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A realized tactic quality payoff is claimed; a model-internal prediction retains its narrower formal or analytic scope.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A tactic name or improved local parameter guarantees overall quality.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Additional measurement may be expensive or distort behaviour.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Its causal model has a declared envelope.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Calibrate the model and account for competing/external costs.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Hard constraints and cross-quality consequences limit economic, adaptation and sustainability optimization before preferences rank feasible options.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: The highest utility candidate violates a latency requirement.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Feasibility alone does not establish optimality or legitimacy of the preferences.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Optimisation remains inside acceptable cross-quality and external obligations.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Economic, adaptive or sustainability optimisation selects a change.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Any objective can be compensated by enough benefit elsewhere.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Conflicting non-negotiable obligations may make all options infeasible.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Hard constraints are distinguished from negotiable preferences.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Resolve genuine stakeholder conflict outside an arbitrary weighted sum.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Observed behavior can reopen scenario selection, causal models and allowed changes where the observation actually bears on their premises.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: One atypical load result is used to invalidate every unrelated model claim.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A revised model does not establish that the new observations are representative.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Observed behaviour reopens scenarios, models, tests and allowed changes rather than merely adding a report.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Actual behaviour contradicts or qualifies a prediction or signal.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Prior model approval overrides new observation.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Repeated noisy observations may cause churn or unstable policies.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Measurements have a stated scope and reliability.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Distinguish actual contradiction from invalid instrumentation.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Selected views communicate structures and relevant rationale; correspondence and decision records use them where their consumers need the information.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A logical view is handed to an operator who needs placement and recovery semantics.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A decision record may carry adequate reasoning without a separate view set.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Concern-selected views carry structures and reasons to implementers/evaluators with relevant correspondence links.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Different consumers need selected architectural views.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Every audience needs the same full description.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: More views multiply update and interpretation work.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Each view serves an identified question and refers to known entities.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Demonstrate that intended consumers interpret the view adequately.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Correspondence evidence connects formal, conformance and runtime model conclusions to realization, but does not prove omitted environmental assumptions.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A source mapping is current while the deployment configuration is stale.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A true real-system property does not prove that the selected model or mapping is correct.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Correspondence checks support, but do not complete, the move from model conclusions to actual software.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A formal, conformance or runtime model is relied upon.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Model consistency alone supplies real-world validation.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Mappings can become a second stale system.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The mapping refers to the relation or behaviour in the claim.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Close the required refinement and observation gaps.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Formal reasoning and experiments are alternatives only for an overlapping uncertainty and may be complementary. Their conclusions have different domains.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A finite benchmark is selected as a substitute for an unbounded semantic theorem.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Neither method globally supersedes the other; reverse substitution must fit the actual question.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Use a formal model for tractable semantic guarantees, an experiment for behaviour with weak models, or a targeted combination.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A specific architectural uncertainty can be analysed or experimentally explored.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Formal analysis and prototypes are interchangeable for every property.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Two methods can duplicate cost or share the same mistaken assumptions.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The chosen method addresses the same consequential question.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Choose evidence that can actually discriminate the alternatives.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Wright refines general connector/formal reasoning with specific semantics and theorem premises, including conservative glue.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: Compatibility is checked while conservatism is omitted.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Generic semantic compatibility does not imply Wright compatibility or the theorem’s premises.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: The formal theorem narrows admissible connector reasoning and exposes the non-conservative-glue failure.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: The selected formalism is Wright/CSP architectural connection.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Port compatibility by itself implies deadlock freedom.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Checking all conditions and realisation mapping adds specialist work.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Conservative deadlock-free connector and compatible ports satisfy the theorem conditions.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Implementation refinement remains separate from the model theorem.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Recovery supplies a current hypothesis for correspondence and migration when descriptions are suspect; its uncertain parts remain visible.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A reconstructed graph is silently treated as approved intended architecture.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A valid migration does not require recovering irrelevant parts of the entire system.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Triangulated recovery supplies a current structural basis for comparison and migration.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Descriptions are absent or suspect and a change is planned.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Inferred structure reveals original intent without history.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Extraction, tracing and human interpretation can be costly or incomplete.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Recovered claims are labelled by their evidence and uncertainty.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Resolve decision-critical unknowns without claiming complete recovery.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Alternative comparison constrains method choice by decision value and feasibility; it does not demand the most elaborate method to compare itself exhaustively.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: An expensive evaluation consumes the capacity needed to address an obvious dominant risk.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Using a cheaper method does not establish adequate evidence unless its protected concern is met.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Select the least costly evidence-producing design/evaluation branch adequate to the question.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A method is being chosen for an architectural decision.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Completing a named method is itself the objective.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Premature method choice can exclude a better alternative.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Feasible alternatives and no-change are compared on common conditions.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Confirm added analysis can change the decision or protect a material risk.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: SAAM-like change walkthroughs and ATAM-like multi-quality reviews are guarded alternatives with overlapping techniques, not competing universal maturity levels.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A narrow change question is forced through a full multistakeholder event with no extra discriminating information.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: An ATAM label does not imply that change impacts were adequately considered.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Use a SAAM-like change walkthrough for a narrow modification question, ATAM-like review for interacting quality risks.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Change impact is the main concern versus interacting qualities.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Every change review must become a full multi-quality workshop.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: A too-narrow choice can miss cross-quality consequences.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Scenario reasoning supports both, but their questions differ.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Check whether the actual decision requires the broader branch.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Review findings inform investment and later rationale, carrying their scenarios and assumptions with them.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A conditional non-risk is copied into a permanent decision without its load assumption.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Economic preference or a rationale record does not retrospectively validate the review.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Risk and trade-off information informs investment and preserves reopening conditions in decision knowledge.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A structured review has found risks and sensitivity points.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A review is a quality certificate or objective monetary valuation.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Unprioritised lists can overwhelm consumers and become ceremonial records.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Findings remain conditional on their scenarios/assumptions.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Validate findings and connect them to an actual decision.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Sensitive costs or utilities can reopen option generation or tradeoff choices where rankings actually change.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: Small irrelevant estimate changes trigger wholesale redesign although the choice is robust.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A new alternative does not prove the original economic estimate was wrong.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Sensitivity can trigger new alternatives, revised priorities or abandonment of an uneconomic change.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Cost or utility uncertainty changes option ranking or feasibility.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A single numerical ranking permanently settles architecture.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: False precision may make uncertainty less visible.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Economic quantities are plausible and dependencies handled.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Seek evidence where plausible assumptions reverse the decision.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: A focused model or prototype can supply evidence for a tactic, option or refinement only at its declared fidelity.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: An isolated throughput test is used to justify a deployment with untested shared-state contention.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A sound design does not prove a particular prototype predicted it accurately.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Results refine tactic choice, architectural alternatives and requirement allocation.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A prototype or analysis resolves a concrete uncertainty.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Prototype feasibility proves production fitness.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Experimental scaffolding can be mistaken for production capability.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Its omitted behaviour and operating envelope are explicit.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Validate transfer to the intended implementation and environment.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Driver-based refinement uses responsibility, interface, interaction and quality reasoning as functions, without mandating every pattern or a fixed phase order.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: All ADD steps are ticked off while the chosen tactic does not address the driver.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A useful boundary can be designed through another method; ADD is not necessary ancestry.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: ADD realises design through responsibility allocation, interfaces, interactions and quality reasoning.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Deliberate driver-based decomposition is useful.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Eight completed steps prove the resulting architecture.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Recursive decomposition can overproduce structure or paperwork.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Prioritised drivers can guide but not fully predetermine design.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Evaluate the actual allocation rather than its procedural completeness.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Local refinement evidence can reopen parent drivers and options when it exposes an actual incompatibility.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A low-level naming change triggers reapproval of unrelated system requirements.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A changed parent decision does not establish that a child test discovered the need.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: New local evidence reopens drivers, alternatives or experiments at the necessary level.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Child-element analysis or testing exposes a parent-level problem.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Requirements and top-level choices are immutable after the first pass.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Unbounded redesign can prevent convergence if no decision relevance is applied.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Design analysis, synthesis and evaluation can interleave.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Limit reopening to evidence that changes a consequential choice.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Rationale can transfer non-obvious constraints to future decision makers without the original author; it must be current enough and findable.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A short record preserves the choice but not the rejected alternative that matters during migration.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Successful handover does not require one record format or prove that every rationale note was useful.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Rationale transfers constraints and trade-offs to successors without requiring the original architect’s presence.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Later actors must continue, coordinate or revise non-obvious work.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: More documents automatically mean better shared knowledge.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Stale notes and unindexed archives can increase confusion.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Retained context can be retrieved and interpreted.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Test a real later consumer’s question and update cost.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: A changed rationale premise feeds into significance, conformance, options and flexibility only along consequential dependencies.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: An old date alone is treated as invalidating a still-correct constraint.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A revised check or design does not imply every supporting decision became obsolete.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Ageing/reopening revises significance, alternatives, conformance and future-flexibility investments.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A decision’s assumption or consumer changes.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Historical authorisation makes a decision permanently valid.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Automatic expiry can create empty repeated review.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Status and dependencies identify affected obligations.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Identify which changed assumption is decision-relevant.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Adequate coordination enables local decisions and sensible placement across dependencies; meetings are one possible mechanism, not the criterion.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: More meetings are added to teams with no relevant shared dependency.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Local autonomy does not demonstrate coordination adequacy across an omitted invariant.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Adequate coordination supports local autonomy and informs boundary adjustments.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Technical/work dependencies cross independent teams.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Reorganisation alone guarantees modular software.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Too much communication defeats independent work and creates bottlenecks.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Relevant communication can be changed without assuming deterministic mirroring.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Establish the local causal bottleneck, not just correlation.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Local decisions affecting shared consumers need applicable contract, quality and justified baseline information; these functions need not be separate governance artifacts.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A team changes an interface while assuming no current consumers without checking.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A conformance system does not itself create legitimate local decision rights.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Teams need interface, quality and justified constraint information to decide safely within bounds.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Local decisions can affect shared consumers.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Autonomy removes the need to preserve common invariants.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Overbroad shared rules can make autonomy nominal.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Shared obligations are explicit and still valid.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Show that retained global constraints protect actual shared consequences.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: A conformance result communicates a question for adjudication, not an unconditional repair command.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: An extraction false positive is automatically fixed by damaging a valid design.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A justified design revision may arise without any detector warning.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Conformance supplies a question for adjudication rather than an unquestionable repair instruction.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: An extracted/observed deviation is found.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A deviation is automatically harmful or automatically acceptable evolution.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Adjudication can become a slow exception queue.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Finding includes rule, mapping, actual relation and protected concern.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Resolve current baseline relevance and actual consequence.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Adjudication feeds corrections to the appropriate code, baseline, rationale or check and then checks the affected result.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: The baseline is edited solely to make the warning disappear despite a surviving harmful dependency.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Changing a rule does not establish that the original deviation was beneficial.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Adjudication updates the decision/rule or execution and then checks the actual resulting state.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Evidence supports revision of the code, rule, model or transition.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Only implementation may change; the baseline cannot be wrong.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: An unjustified exception can erase a useful control.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The correct object of repair is identified and change is authorised.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Recheck the retained obligation after either baseline or implementation revision.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: A smell or classifier signal supplies defeasible triage evidence, not intent, harm or debt valuation.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: High classification accuracy on balanced comments is treated as production incident detection accuracy.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A harmful architecture may have no recognized smell or review comment.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: A signal prioritises recovery, conformance inspection or debt diagnosis without substituting for it.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A smell/classifier produces a potentially relevant signal.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A score is itself architectural harm or debt interest.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Proxy optimisation can relocate complexity or flood review with noise.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Indicator semantics and errors are understood.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Calibrate operational precision and establish the causal consequence.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: A causal burden estimate can inform migration timing and flexibility investment while leaving no-repayment viable.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: An obsolete technology name is entered as debt without any expected cost mechanism.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A worthwhile migration may be driven by a new capability rather than debt.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Evidence of burden informs repair timing, migration alternatives and investment in flexibility.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A structural compromise has observed or credible future burden.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Every debt-labelled item must be repaid immediately.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Overstated interest can crowd out more valuable work.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Debt is separated from ordinary imperfection and predictions are labelled.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Compare remediation with retaining the compromise under uncertainty.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Migration requires the applicable contracts, tradeoffs, observations and decision continuity across intermediate states; rollback is only one possible recovery method.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: Both final versions pass tests but the mixed-version phase loses an external effect.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Stable contracts alone do not make a migration beneficial or feasible.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Migration needs contracts, accepted trade-offs, observations and updated decision knowledge for each relevant transition.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Old/new structures coexist or an irreversible transition is planned.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Only the final design matters or rollback is always possible.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Temporary bridges, dual writes and long coexistence add risk.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Compatibility and current commitments apply to intermediate states.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Verify transition-state safety and retire obsolete compatibility mechanisms.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: A fitness signal prompts interpretation, observation review and appropriate reopening rather than automatically commanding a fixed repair.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A green check masks an unobserved dependency while a red check flags authorized evolution.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A needed architecture change can be discovered without an automated fitness signal.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Continuous feedback triggers observation review, decision reopening or justified exception handling.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A maintained check finds deterioration or a changed assumption.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Green or red status automatically decides overall acceptability.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Automation can speed up incorrect judgements as well as useful detection.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The check measures a concern and someone can adjudicate the signal.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Verify that the signal still predicts the concern.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Architecture-based adaptation relies jointly on constrained choices, valid observations and correspondence; a loop’s existence does not discharge them.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: Freshly timestamped but semantically wrong data corrupts the runtime model.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A safe fixed configuration can satisfy the same concern without runtime adaptation.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: The runtime loop needs constrained decisions, observed effects and maintained model-to-system correspondence.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Architecture-based runtime adaptation is enabled.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Local objective improvement is sufficient global assurance.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Monitoring and control overhead; oscillation and stale-model risks.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Model/effectors/observations correspond and actions have an admissible envelope.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Establish the envelope and detect invalid observation/action channels.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Constraints limit both ordinary adaptation and policy revision; the control loop cannot remove an external obligation merely to regain feasibility.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A policy update widens its own allowable action set after failing a requirement.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Preserving a constraint does not imply all adaptation objectives are achieved.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Allowed transitions and revision rules remain bounded by consequences that the controller cannot self-authorise away.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Adaptation or controller revision changes the real system.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: The optimiser may relax a constraint because doing so raises its score.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: An overly narrow envelope may prevent useful adaptation.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: External/system constraints remain independently justified.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Provide an authorised path to revise genuine obsolete constraints.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Changing the observation/policy/assurance basis requires targeted rechecking of the altered assumption chain and decision continuity.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: Only action code is tested after a threshold change that admits unsafe actions.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Unchanged claims can remain supported; no universal rebuild of all assurance follows.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Validate changed sensing/deciding/acting assumptions and preserve traceable authority/constraint continuity.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Observation model, policy or assurance basis is revised.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: The successor policy’s own score is enough to warrant its revision.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Meta-checking can recurse without limit if no bounded stopping rule is chosen.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Continuity can be checked under a valid prior acceptance basis.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: The literature does not supply unrestricted recursive self-revision; choose a bounded human-accountable process.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Expected future flexibility constrains whether seams, variants and deployment options are worth maintaining, not whether every possibility must be implemented.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: An unused plugin system burdens ordinary change for an imagined product family.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A simple design is not necessarily inflexible in the relevant future direction.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Flexibility investment selects which seams, variants and deployment options are worth maintaining.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Architecture machinery is justified by future optionality.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Future-proofing warrants unlimited abstraction or distribution.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Wrong forecasts can under- or over-invest.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Credible change hypotheses and present costs are examined.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Review actual change evidence and retirement opportunities.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Microservices and modular monoliths are real deployment alternatives under the independence guard; hybrids and coarse services remain possible.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A required independent security boundary is ignored to simplify deployment.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Choosing services does not imply all future decisions should move toward finer granularity.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Independent deployments and a coherent local deployment substitute according to actual needs.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A service boundary may or may not require independent operation.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: One alternative is universally more mature.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Migration between configurations can itself be costly.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Comparison includes data, failure, coordination and release costs.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Test which independence is actually exercised and beneficial.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Provider-managed execution brings provider/workload premises into ordinary interface, interaction and quality reasoning; historical limits need current checking when applied.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A 2019 provider limit is assumed unchanged in a present deployment recommendation.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Meeting a workload target does not establish portability or provider-independent semantics.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Provider contracts and workload evidence re-enter normal architecture reasoning rather than bypass it.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Provider-managed execution/services are used.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Serverless removes operational dependencies or always reduces cost.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Provider opacity and rapid change can weaken evidence.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Platform-version semantics and external dependency boundaries are known.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Obtain current platform-specific measurements and contract evidence in a later target.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Learned components refine dependency and observation obligations with data and feedback relations; this does not redefine all code as ML architecture.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: The interface is unchanged but a data distribution or undeclared consumer changes the system effect.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Ordinary interface adequacy does not establish learned-component adequacy.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Add data, consumer and feedback dependencies to interface/evidence/reopening obligations.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Learned components affect system outcomes.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A stable code signature guarantees a stable behavioural contract.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Monitoring and model/data governance expand the coordination surface.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Data/model/population changes can alter effective behaviour.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Identify target-specific distribution shift, feedback and downstream consumers.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: Checked AI proposals can contribute evidence only through the checks that validate them. S047/S059/S062 are LLM-related task evidence; S063 is a non-LLM comparator; ArchBench is infrastructure.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: A model’s confident self-measured coupling score is accepted without measurement.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: A verified architectural fact does not show that AI improved total effort over direct work.

relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Verified suggestions may contribute to recovery, evaluation and documentation; unverified suggestions remain candidates.
relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: AI assistance proposes architectural facts/options/risks.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Model fluency or self-reported metrics are evidence of correctness.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Validation may cost more than the assisted work saved.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Outputs are independently checked and their provenance retained.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Measure correctness and total effort in the actual task, not benchmark reputation.

AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.author_adjudication: A sustainability choice requires a stated response boundary, cross-quality constraints and appropriate evidence; economic reasoning is proportional cost assessment, not mandatory CBAM machinery.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.discriminating_failure: CPU energy is reported as whole-lifecycle carbon and mean-latency cost is omitted.
AUTHOR_REQUALIFICATION.reverse_or_converse_limit: Economic attractiveness does not establish environmental or social benefit.
